elevate.move: Make each era a true specimen pair: enlarge each arch to ~40% of the row and fill it with a photo that shows that era's failure (loose keys, a sheet-edge crack, a nail pop), and draw the plate's leader lines across into the photo so the drawing annotates the real wall.

Give the tools and the header the plates' precision: one state drives the sizer's row, drawn hole and price, and the header holds one line at every width from 1024 up, so the page behaves like an exact instrument at every size.
